{{Quote|Hey lieutenant, what'a got there?|Rebel Crewman to Ezra Bridger|<ref name="Twin Suns" />}}
A '''crewman''' was a [[human]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Twin Suns" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> at [[Chopper Base]], the crewman attempted to prevent [[Ezra Bridger]] from stealing an [[RZ-1T trainer]] to go off on an [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|unauthorized mission]].<ref name="Twin Suns" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The rebel crewman is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]],<ref name="Twin Suns" /> who also voices [[Rex|Captain Rex]] on ''Rebels'' and the [[clone trooper]]s in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
